observations: Three photos show a stage lighting fixture with a rotating head and a fixed base.
The fixture is dark gray or black with a glossy finish.
The brand 'BEAM' is visible in red text on a black oval sticker on the front of the head in all three photos.
The model '300' is also visible in red text on the same sticker in photos 0 and 2.
The word 'EXCELLENCE' is printed in white on the front of the base in all three photos.
The fixture has a large lens at the top, a rotating arm, and a control panel on the front of the base.
The control panel has a dial and some buttons, but no visible power switch or indicator lights.
The background shows a person sitting on a chair, suggesting an indoor setting.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'EXECUTIVE.C.LIGHT' are overlaid on all photos.
